proposal.reason: Main change adds a full independent TROCE GIN backend (new host/device GIN implementation, plugin registration, GIN type/device enums, context/MR lifecycle, and device-side put/get/flush/wait paths). Additional network review is needed because shared net_ib infrastructure is substantively changed (provider classification in init, common GDR-support helper/interface refactor, and shared IB/GIN connection helpers) beyond purely local caller wiring.
